d:
A mature adult with a broad, mountainous build and stern, glowing ember-orange eyes. The hair and thick, coarse beard are long and shaggy in a shade of charcoal black. The body is an anthropomorphic bovine creature with large, curved horns and a thick, tufted tail in slate grey. The outfit consists of heavy leather aprons and smithing gear in dark brown.
BODY COLOR: slate-grey
